scope: Inter-brain synchrony, covert consciousness, psychedelic telepathy testimony, nonspeaking autism, The Hill, NDE and mediumship
retrieval_limits: Podcast catalogue descriptions were reviewed; full audio transcripts were not retrieved or verified.
Reddit post bodies were not retrievable in this environment; URLs and titles are preserved as user-supplied discovery records.
Host descriptions and guest statements are not treated as independent verification.
No apparent entity, telepathic channel, survival claim or shared nonphysical place is authenticated.

sources.title: Ky Dickens Has Proof Telepathy & Psychic Abilities Are Real!
sources.claim_boundary: Records programme claims and discussion topics only; does not establish telepathy or a shared nonphysical environment.

sources.title: Part Two: Near Death Experiences, Telepathy & the Multiverse. An Astrophysicist Explains
sources.claim_boundary: Expert discussion and hypothesis generation are not empirical demonstration of telepathy, survival or multiverse access.

sources.title: No One Is Judged When They Die. Even Abusers Apologize
sources.claim_boundary: Mediumship and after-death statements remain attributed testimony; no survival claim is promoted.

sources.title: Sharon Stone Saw the Afterlife: 5 Orbs Told Her to Stay & Share Their Message (Parts One and Two)
sources.claim_boundary: Preserves a first-person account without authenticating apparent entities, reincarnation or postmortem survival.

sources.title: CIA Mind Control, MKUltra & Energy Weapons Are Real: Why A Pentagon Advisor Won't Rule Out Telepathy
sources.claim_boundary: Not ruling out a mechanism is not positive evidence for it; historical programme facts remain separate from paranormal claims.

sources.title: Lisa Kudrow consciousness and intuition conversation (two parts)
sources.claim_boundary: Preserves attributed experience without treating claircognizance as established information transfer.

sources.title: LSD, Caudate Nucleus, Microdosing, Telepathy, ICPR
sources.claim_boundary: Discovery record only until post body and cited sources receive claim-level review.

sources.title: Hidden Consciousness Detected in 25% of Unresponsive Patients Tested
sources.claim_boundary: Covert command-following after severe brain injury does not demonstrate telepathy and is only a bounded analogy to nonspeaking autism.

sources.publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.title: Speaker-listener neural coupling underlies successful communication
sources.claim_boundary: Supports neural coupling during ordinary communication; does not establish unaided distant thought transfer.

sources.title: Cognitive Motor Dissociation in Disorders of Consciousness
sources.claim_boundary: Demonstrates that behavioural unresponsiveness can conceal cognition in some brain-injured patients; does not establish telepathy or generalise directly to autism.

sources.title: Psychedelic Communitas: Intersubjective Experience During Psychedelic Group Sessions Predicts Enduring Changes in Psychological Wellbeing and Social Connectedness
sources.claim_boundary: Supports perceived togetherness in psychedelic group settings; does not demonstrate shared visions or nonlocal information transfer.

candidate_links.note: Covert or underestimated cognition motivates better assessment but does not validate facilitated communication or telepathy.
Ordinary neural alignment and psychedelic communitas are plausible context for perceived mind-sharing.
Candidate cluster for future preregistered tests of inaccessible target information under sensory isolation.

test_requirements: Preregister targets, matching rules, exclusions and stopping criteria.
Record reports independently before participant contact or feedback.
Use sensory isolation, randomized targets, time synchronization and tamper-evident logs.
Separate accuracy from confidence, vividness and retrospective similarity.
Replicate across independent teams and include adversarial leakage review.
If hyperscanning is used, test whether cross-brain prediction exceeds shared-stimulus and physiological confounds.
next_gate: Human review of exact episode pages or transcripts and cited primary sources before any canonical BQ or public-page integration.
